review_comment: Basic authentication credentials are directly embedded into URLs, exposing them in plaintext. The vulnerability occurs when get_request_basic_auth() extracts credentials from HTTP_AUTHORIZATION and urlunsplit() incorporates them into the URL without sanitization. This creates a clear path from attacker-controlled input to credential exposure in the URL. Remove the embedding of credentials in the URL or enforce secure transport for URLs containing credentials.

The function retrieves and decodes basic authentication data from HTTP headers without performing any authorization checks. This creates a potential vulnerability where unauthorized actors could potentially gain access to resources if the returned credentials are used downstream without proper authorization validation. The function should implement proper authorization verification before returning decoded credentials.

The code allows external configuration of webhook_url which can be used to control the URL in signature validation. If webhook_url is attacker-controlled, it could enable SSRF by directing signature computation to an unintended destination. Add validation or restriction of webhook_url to prevent untrusted URLs from being used.
